meta.name: pm-skill-creator
meta.description: Design a new PM skill through guided conversation. Use when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话将想法转化为合规技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有原始内容或想法，想把它塑造成一个合规的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw ideas into compliant skills through guided conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

howto.what: 它通过最多5轮对话，帮你把想法或资料梳理成一份符合格式的SKILL.md草稿，自动判断技能类型，并生成所有必需章节。
howto.when: 当你有想法或原始内容，想把它变成符合规范的技能时触发；也会在你说“帮我设计一个新技能”时启动。

say.text: 我有工作坊笔记，想把它变成一个技能。
say.note: 它会先问几个问题，然后给你草稿。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新技能，主题是定价策略。
say.note: 它会先确认技能类型，再逐步收集内容。

say.text: 我有原始内容，用上下文转储模式吧。
say.note: 它会分析内容并提议技能结构。

howto.what_en: It walks you through up to 5 questions to turn raw ideas or content into a formatted SKILL.md draft, determines the skill type, and generates all required sections.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill, or when you ask to create a new skill.

say_en.text: I have workshop notes, help me turn them into a skill.
say_en.note: It will ask a few questions and return a draft.

say_en.text: Help me design a new skill for pricing strategy.
say_en.note: It will confirm the skill type and gather details.

say_en.text: I have raw content, use context dump mode.
say_en.note: It will analyze the content and propose a structure.
